answer: A farm of 137 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are recorded in spiral, queued in cedar, and inlet publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 44 identities per epoch. A farm of 1705 identities would post 991 proofs and burn roughly 70 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
